question: Who took over as the new President of India International Centre (IIC) in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shyam Saran.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shyam Saran took over as the new President of the India International Centre (IIC) in June 2022.**
 
• He succeeded Karan Singh who held the **position for 23 years.**
 
• Shyam Saran is a retired **Indian Foreign Service (IFS) **officer who served as the Foreign Secretary of India from 2004 to 2006.
 
• He has also served as India's Ambassador to Myanmar, Indonesia, and Nepal.
 
• ** India International Centre (IIC) **is a premier cultural institution in New Delhi, India, which promotes cultural and intellectual exchange between India and other countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Karan Singh** is an Indian politician and a former member of Parliament.

 
 
• He served as the** President of the India International Centre (IIC) for 23 years** before Shyam Saran.
 
 
 
• ** Narinder Nath Vohra** is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer who served as the Governor of Jammu and Kashmir from 2008 to 2018.
 
 
• He has no connection with the India International Centre (IIC).
 
 
 
• **Kamaladevi Chattopadhyaya** was an Indian social reformer and freedom fighter who played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
 
 
• She passed away in 1988 and has no connection with India International Centre (IIC).
